stories.title: RBI's bond sales & FX intervention halve liquidity surplus
stories.body: surplus fell to ₹4.92 trillion on 21 Sept (down 55% from record ₹11.16 trillion); RBI sold ₹750 bn bonds in a week, ₹250 bn more planned; diaspora deposit scheme had raised $133 bn; ANZ expects three 25bp hikes from Oct 2026, repo to 6.00% by end-FY27.

stories.title: RBI extends simplified KYC certification for FPIs at co-operative banks
stories.body: effective 18 Sept 2026; FPIs at Urban/Rural Co-operative Banks put on par with NRIs/PIOs; no physical in-person verification required under PMLA norms.

stories.title: RBI bulk-deposit rate disclosure rules from 1 Oct 2026
stories.body: banks must publish rates on their websites; 10-minute grace after the 10 am daily deadline.

stories.title: SEBI pushes banks into commodity derivatives; RBI/IRDAI hold back
stories.body: SEBI Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey bats for bank/pension-fund entry to deepen liquidity and hedging; MCX shares fell 3.4% on the commentary.

stories.title: Tarang Shakti 2026: F-35s to fly with IAF for the first time
stories.body: 2nd edition at Jodhpur, 26 Sept–12 Oct 2026; 7 friendly foreign air forces with assets (US F-35s, French Rafales, UAE F-16s; Germany, Australia, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka), 32 nations as observers; announced by Vice Chief of Air Staff Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit on 22 Sept.

stories.title: First-ever V4+India Foreign Ministers' Meeting
stories.body: held 21 Sept in New York on the sidelines of the 81st UNGA; Jaishankar met ministers of Czechia, Hungary, Poland & Slovakia; annual ministerial meet + annual business forum agreed; V4 backed India's UNSC permanent-seat bid.

stories.title: Ireland fines Google €403 million over location-data privacy
stories.body: DPC's GDPR action announced 21 Sept over Web & App Activity, Location History and Location Accuracy (2018–20); Google must comply within 6 months; 4th-largest fine by the Irish regulator.

stories.title: 72nd National Film Awards presented at Ekta Nagar, Gujarat
stories.body: first ceremony held outside Delhi; President Murmu conferred the honours on 22 Sept. Dadasaheb Phalke Award 2024: Anant Nag; Best Feature Film: Article 370; Best Actress: Yami Gautam; Best Actor (shared): Mammootty (Bramayugam) & Kartik Aaryan (Chandu Champion); Best Director: Rajkumar Periasamy (Amaran); Best Popular Film: Kalki 2898 AD; Best Non-Feature: Bhangaar; first Santhali film honoured.

stories.title: India's first gold at Asian Games 2026
stories.body: women's cricket beat Sri Lanka by 147 runs in the T20 final (216/3 vs 69) at Korogi Sports Park, Nisshin, on 22 Sept; Mandhana 79 off 45 — became the first batter in women's cricket to 11,000 international runs; India's tally: 1 gold, 4 silver, 2 bronze.

stories.title: Suchika Tariyal wins bronze in MMA
stories.body: India's first-ever Asian Games MMA medal, women's traditional 60kg (21 Sept); lost to Singapore's Teo Hui Hoon in the semifinal.

stories.title: Men's 10m air rifle team silver
stories.body: Rudrankksh Patil, Parth Mane & Himanshu Dhillon (Asian Games, 21 Sept).

stories.title: 11th Ayurveda Day — 23 September
stories.body: theme "Ayurveda for a Healthier Tomorrow"; main celebrations in Nagpur, Maharashtra; National Dhanwantari Ayurveda Awards; Ministry of Ayush.

stories.title: World Rhino Day — 22 September
stories.body: theme "Keep the Five Alive"; ~26,700 rhinos globally; Greater One-Horned ~4,075 in India/Nepal; Kaziranga the major stronghold.
